articles.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
articles.description: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.
articles.author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai

articles.title: Claude Opus 5 became downright ruthless when tasked with running a vending machine
articles.description: Andon Labs' latest vending machine simulation shows Opus 5 lied and colluded its way to become the best AI capitalist ever.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
articles.description: OpenAI's CEO seemed excited to share a "cool use case" for parents.
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
articles.description: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
articles.description: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: Sam Altman is ready to decelerate
articles.description: His change of position comes after "the first security incident that I have felt very viscerally."
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Thinking Machines co-founder Lilian Weng left the company citing health reasons, then joined OpenAI
articles.description: Weng previously served as the VP of AI Safety Research at OpenAI.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: Google’s AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
articles.description: Google’s AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, underscoring how quickly AI-generated answers are becoming the default way people discover information online.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Judge says Trump admin still lacks evidence for Anthropic ‘supply-chain risk’ label
articles.description: A federal judge said the Trump administration has not presented enough evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply-chain risk, casting doubt on the government's ban on its AI technology.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
articles.description: The decision arrives as the breakneck pace of data center construction has grid operators scrambling to generate power.
articles.author: Tim De Chant
